description: Give a colleague feedback in Workday ("Give Feedback"), optionally with a badge. `to` is their name; `feedback` is plain text (blank line = new paragraph); `badge` is part of a badge name (the preview lists them if it does not match); `sharing` sets who sees it. The feedback goes on their Workday profile with the visibility shown in the preview. After submitting, your Feedback Given is re-read to verify. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

badge.description: A badge, by part of its name, e.g. `own it`.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

sharing.description: Who sees the feedback: `everyone` = Workday's "Share with others" (the usual default); `private` = Workday's "Share with …" one person — the recipient when giving feedback, you ("Share with me") on a request; `confidential` = "Don't share with <the person it is about>". Omit to keep the form's default. The preview shows Workday's exact label.

to.description: The colleague's name, as Workday's people search finds them.

name: workday_give_feedback
title: Give a colleague feedback
